The First God

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/The_First_God

Brother Humphries, a priest of The First God who resides among abandoned shrines (15.16), keeps the Shrine of the First God with a collection of broken holy symbols. He is a capable divine caster.

He preaches that humans are the first and only true gods and that their souls are the source of all divine magic. According to him, all of the so-called gods are nothing but bloated parasites who feed on the souls of man.

Hooks

*Is anything that Brother Humphries says is true? If it’s not then why can he use divine magic? *If only human souls contain the spark of the divine, then what of the other races and their gods? Category:Deities
